about.p1: I am passionate about technology and building digital solutions. I develop modern websites, custom systems and interfaces that combine performance, design and an excellent user experience.
about.p2: My focus is creating digital products that are fast, secure, scalable and visually distinctive. Every project starts by understanding the client's real problem — and ends with something they can use, measure and build on.

tochegando.title: Tô Chegando Bar & Restaurant
tochegando.problem: The venue took reservations only by phone and messages, with no organized record and lost requests at peak hours.
tochegando.solution: A complete website with an online reservation system, digital menu, gallery, FAQ and direct WhatsApp contact. Instagram integration keeps the page alive with no manual work.
tochegando.imageAlt: Home page of the Tô Chegando Bar & Restaurant website
